data.scaling: existing authors' per-recording scaling uses unlabeled target recording data; this is not strict transfer without access to target data

preprocessing_decision.reason: User explicitly requested the authors' cleaned-data pipeline before the first real exp10 run.

download_provenance.raw: MEG-MASC NEMAR mirror nm000229 v1.0.1, all files checked against manifest checksums
download_provenance.events: NEMAR events restored to OSF dictionary representation by repository nemar_events_to_osf.py; event timing and signals preserved
download_provenance.osf_crosscheck: OSF sub-11/ses-0/task-0 RAW SHA-256 matches NEMAR manifest: e1152af992717906e71188acaa5c1d1837de219394253b30584ddbd541e51d45
download_provenance.reason: 2026-11-05: user authorized autonomous work and requested first results by 10:00 MSK; mirror selected after faster transfer probe, clean ICA method unchanged

split.rule: test=fold[k], validation=fold[(k+1)%9], train=remaining 21 subjects; both sessions when available
split.training_windows: canonical df_train27 excluding validation sound, train subjects only
split.validation_windows: canonical df_train27 validation sound, validation subjects only
split.calibration_budget: 0 labeled target windows; no target gradient updates

routing.unit: independent Bernoulli per example, resampled each training forward
routing.evaluation: deterministic common matrix for all validation/test subjects; individual baseline uses mean of training slots only

training.objective: upstream CLIPLoss, duplicate wav_index positives deduplicated, AdamW; skip batches with fewer than two distinct audio windows
training.checkpoint: maximum macro-subject validation Top-10, break ties by macro-subject Top-1, keep earlier epoch on exact ties
training.probability_selection: per fold and seed, best switch checkpoint validation Top-10 then Top-1; smaller p on exact tie; test never used

evaluation.rank: zero-based count of candidates with strictly larger cosine similarity; same frozen evaluator convention as exp09
evaluation.aggregation: windows -> subject across available sessions -> average over seeds within subject -> mean and 95% t interval over subjects
evaluation.statistics: paired Wilcoxon across subjects, Holm correction across the three Top-10 comparisons; exploratory for partial folds
evaluation.comparison_to_exp09: historical numbers are contextual only: exp10 trains on 21 subjects and selects checkpoints on unseen validation subjects
